metadata.name: Jumping ZeroTwo
metadata.description: Adds ZeroTwo onto your progress bar.

files.index.css: .player-controls .playback-progressbar::before { content: ''; width: 32px; height: 32px; bottom: calc(100% - 4px); left: 10px; position: absolute; image-rendering: pixelated; background-size: 32px 32px; background-image: url('https://media.tenor.com/vuMDJNZY76sAAAAi/jumping-blushing.gif'); }
